biological_support.statistical_interpretation: RNA shows a strong, coherent down-regulation of metabolic and secretory pathways (pancreas beta cells, fatty acid metabolism, adipogenesis, protein secretion) with large negative SMDs and low q-values. WXS and CNV show no significant enrichment after FDR correction; effect sizes are moderate but confidence intervals are wide and q-values are high, indicating low statistical confidence. The dominant pattern is RNA-driven metabolic down-regulation, with no coherent genomic (mutation or CNV) support.
biological_support.medical_interpretation: The RNA pattern suggests reduced expression of metabolic and secretory programs in this set relative to the rest. This is a molecular characterization only; no clinical or prognostic claims are made.
limitations: WXS and CNV analyses are underpowered due to small set size (n=20) and multiple testing.
RNA findings are based on ssGSEA scores and may reflect technical or compositional effects.

biological_support.statistical_interpretation: RNA shows modest up-regulation of pancreas beta cells, heme metabolism, TGF-beta signaling, and UV response down, with moderate SMDs and q~0.035. WXS shows a nominally significant PBRM1 enrichment (Fisher p=0.018) but not significant after FDR (q=0.389). CNV shows significant continuous lower copy number on chr20q, chr16p, chr7p, chr12p, chr7q, but gain/loss analyses are not significant after FDR. The dominant pattern is a combination of RNA up-regulation and CNV loss on several chromosomal arms, but WXS and CNV gain/loss are not FDR-significant.
biological_support.medical_interpretation: The set shows a distinct RNA expression profile and CNV losses, but the lack of FDR-significant mutation or discrete CNV alterations limits the strength of biological support.
limitations: Small set size (n=19) and multiple testing reduce power.
CNV continuous and gain/loss analyses yield different significance patterns, indicating sensitivity to analysis type.
